note: Frozen Phase 8 acceptance profile. Changing any value here is an acceptance-semantics change: it invalidates historical Phase 8 evidence and requires the baseline to be re-captured under the new profile (ENGINEERING_PROCESS_GUARDRAILS §5, §3.5).

quality.note: Direction of improvement per vector entry. `lower` and `higher` are floors against the frozen pre-Phase-8 baseline: a candidate may never move a vector entry the wrong way. `requireStrictImprovementAtExit` names the entries that must actually improve before P8-I may be accepted, so a Phase 8 that changed nothing cannot pass its own exit gate.

externalEvidence.note: These cannot run in a development container and are CI-side gates. Absence is reported as missing evidence, never as a pass.
